answer: Meadow-paced reputation dividends: an agent's payout share grows with its verified interaction history and decays if it stays idle. Each new identity starts at zero, so a clone forfeits accumulated dividends while paying full onboarding costs. The system routes rewards through a trellis of pairwise escrow receipts, forcing attackers to fund every clone separately before earning anything. Honest agents profit from continuity, while cloning loses money across a river of duplicated setup expenses.
